question.question: Bringer uses a 2-Damage Power and then a separate 1-Damage Power on an undamaged City. What happens? What if 2 then 1 Damage are instructions within a single Power, and may a Repeat pretend-destroy the same piece again?

key.answer: Separate Powers do not combine hypothetical Damage and each does nothing to undamaged City. Repeat is separate action and can pretend-destroy same piece again if its own Damage suffices; cannot combine its hypothetical Damage with original.
